description.en: Bilingual project directory and logo gallery with original artwork and color palettes
description.zh: 个人项目的中英文目录、视觉档案与服务状态页

subject.zh: 奶油色外框与米色、砖红色内片构成的六边形标志

title.zh: 保留已选定的完整轮廓

description.en: A rounded cream frame encloses sand-beige and brick-red inserts with deliberate open channels. Native placement and proportions are unchanged.
description.zh: 圆润奶油色外框包围米色与砖红色内片，保留开口、原始位置和比例。

description.en: The approved 2048px transparent master retains the original opaque RGB values and inspected cutout edges.
description.zh: 已批准的 2048px 透明原图保留全部不透明像素颜色与校验过的边缘。

description.en: Headers and browser marks use the transparent foreground without glow or another mask. Existing neutral square and rounded derivatives serve large and platform presentations.
description.zh: 页头与浏览器标志使用透明前景，不加光晕或额外遮罩；大图和平台展示使用已有纯底方形与圆角版本。

goal.en: Browse bilingual project records, preserved identities, palettes, service observations and reusable video compositions. Public status is a separate Cron/D1 observation system, not a live browser probe.
goal.zh: 浏览双语项目资料、原始身份、色板、服务观测和可复用视频模板。公开状态由 Cron 与 D1 独立采样，不由浏览器即时探测。

role.en: Static delivery and scheduled service observations
role.zh: 静态分发与定时服务观测

description.en: Fine ceramic grain with sparse specimen-layout impressions, leaving a quiet field for the preserved identities.
